name: Sagamore Hill Lounge
description: Sagamore Hill Lounge is a unique Teddy Roosevelt-themed venue offering a distinctive karaoke experience. The atmosphere combines rustic coziness with upscale touches, featuring a curated selection of cocktails and a welcoming vibe. While reviews highlight its creative drinks, inviting ambiance, and friendly staff, there is no specific mention of regular karaoke sessions or private rooms. It’s a great spot for special events or a relaxed night out with a touch of history and charm.
